Class AUStats

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.transport.AUStats
public final class AUStats extends Object
Per-AccessUnit summary statistics — every field is derivable from an AccessUnit without decoding signal-channel payload. Used by the workbench server's stats-only and stats-with-payload download modes.

Cross-language equivalents:

  • Objective-C: TTIOAUStats
  • Python: ttio.transport.stats.AUStats

jsonString() produces a byte-stable form: sorted keys, no whitespace.
